name: Anorexia
overview: Scripture acknowledges the deep affliction of the soul that can lead to a rejection of food, as seen in Psalms where such a state draws one near to death. Yet, the Bible also affirms that we are fearfully and wonderfully made by God, who heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds. Believers are encouraged to take courage and act in faith, embracing the good provision God gives, including the enjoyment of nourishment as a gift and portion from Him.
